description: Quick facts about a PDF for planning the next step: page count, page sizes (points, mm, paper name such as "A4 portrait", grouped by size), rotated pages, encryption, PDF version, form field count, title/author, and which pages have no text layer (scans that would need OCR). Related web tool: https://s3eidat.github.io/pdf-metadata/

file.description: The PDF: a local file path (absolute, or relative to the server's --root) or base64 data (raw or a data: URI).

password.description: Password, for the text check on a protected PDF.

textCheck.description: Check which pages have a text layer (reads up to 500 pages). Default true.

name: pdf_info
title: PDF info
